stance_basis: letter raises no environmental objections but requests coordination and clarification on road relocation and access road responsibilities
summary: The South Carolina State Highway Department reviewed the Draft EIS for the Bad Creek project and offered no environmental objections, but raised concerns about the relocation of Road S-171, the need for cooperation with the Highway Department on that work, and the unclear responsibility for construction and maintenance of the new access road. They also requested close coordination during transmission line construction across state routes to minimize traffic disruption.
complaint_summary: The South Carolina State Highway Department requested assurance of cooperation on the relocation of Road S-171, sought clarification on responsibility for construction and maintenance of the new access road, and asked for close coordination during transmission line construction across S.C. Routes 11 and 183 to minimize traffic disruption.

statement.opening_anchor: We have reviewed your draft environmental impact statement for the Bad Creek project, number 2740 in South Carolina. We have no environmental comments, as such, to offer
statement.closing_anchor:
We appreciate this opportunity to comment on your EIS.

Sincerely your

Paul W. Cobb

State Highway Engineer
